explicit-month.sql: SELECT ReferenceDate, IndexValue FROM analytics.vw_Cpi WHERE PeriodType = 'Month' AND ReferenceDate = @month
explicit-month.explanation: Retrieves the current CPI index value for June 2025 from vw_Cpi.

inflation-wording.sql: SELECT YearOverYearPct FROM analytics.vw_CpiMonthlyChange WHERE ReferenceDate >= DATEADD(month, -12, @today) AND ReferenceDate < @next_month ORDER BY ReferenceDate DESC
inflation-wording.explanation: Retrieves the year-over-year inflation rate (headline CPI change) for each month in the last 12 months from vw_CpiMonthlyChange.

peak.sql: SELECT ReferenceDate, IndexValue FROM analytics.vw_Cpi WHERE PeriodType = 'Month' AND ReferenceYear = @year ORDER BY IndexValue DESC
peak.explanation: Reads the monthly CPI index values for each month in 2024 and returns the row with the highest value.
